title: Front Office Policy on Late Check-out Fees for Guest Folios
content:
**Policy.** A late check-out fee applies to a Guest Folio only when the folio's check-out time is later than the brand's standard check-out time plus the brand's late check-out grace minutes. Up to and including the brand's latest time charged at the late check-out fee, the fee is the brand's flat late check-out fee where the brand's fee basis is a flat fee, or the brand's share of the reservation's nightly rate where the basis is a share of the nightly rate; a check-out later than that time is charged one full night at the nightly rate. Room tax at the reservation's tax rate is added where the brand's late check-out fee bears room tax, and the result is rounded to the cent.

**Elite exemption.** At brands that honour the late check-out time an elite tier guarantees, no fee is charged on a stay credited to an Ashbury Rewards member whose tier guarantees late check-out, provided the check-out time is not later than the late check-out time that tier guarantees; a later departure is charged as if no exemption existed. At brands that do not honour it, the fee applies to every guest. Reservations booked through an online travel agency receive no elite exemption.

**Posting.** The fee is posted only to a folio whose status is open, at most once per stay.

Each brand's figures under this policy — basis, flat fee, share of the nightly rate, latest time charged at the fee, and whether elite guaranteed late check-out is honoured — are the brand's late check-out tariff.

## Bands of the check-out time

| Check-out time on the folio | Charge |
|---|---|
| Not later than the standard check-out time plus the grace minutes | No fee |
| Later than that, up to and including the latest time charged at the fee | The flat fee, or the share of the nightly rate, plus room tax where taxable |
| Later than the latest time charged at the fee | One full night at the nightly rate, plus room tax where taxable |

## Elite exemption, combinations

| Brand honours the elite guarantee | Member's tier guarantees late check-out | Booked through an online travel agency | Check-out not later than the tier's guaranteed time | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No fee |
| Yes | Yes | No | No | Charged as if no exemption existed |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Either | No exemption; charged by the bands above |
| Yes | No | Either | Either | No exemption; charged by the bands above |
| No | Either | Either | Either | Fee applies to every guest by the bands above |

## Worked figures (hypothetical brand and reservation)

Inputs: standard check-out 12:00, grace 30 minutes, basis a share of the nightly rate at 50%, latest time charged at the fee 16:00, fee taxable, nightly rate $200.00, tax rate 12%, no elite exemption.

- Check-out at 12:30: not later than 12:00 plus 30 minutes, so no fee.
- Check-out at 12:31: 50% of $200.00 is $100.00, plus 12% room tax of $12.00, so a fee of $112.00.
- Check-out at 16:00: still up to and including 16:00, so $112.00.
- Check-out at 16:01: one full night of $200.00 plus $24.00 room tax, so $224.00.
